findings: Control character injection vulnerability in anvil/quality.py lines 140 and 146-147. Round 1 finding F3 explicitly required: 'Work order controlled strings interpolated into packet output are sanitized of control characters.' The new same-subject test duty injection code directly interpolates work_order.identity_reference (line 140) and work_order.identity_traits items (line 147) into packet markdown without sanitization. While these fields have path validation against traversal, they lack control character sanitization. An attacker could craft a work order with embedded control characters (ANSI escape codes, null bytes, etc.) that would be injected into reviewer packets. Fix: import and apply the existing _sanitize_control_chars function from anvil.runner (or define an equivalent in quality.py) to sanitize identity_reference and each trait in identity_traits before interpolation.
